status: DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED. Supersedes the leading explanation in g1_piston_behaviour_cloning_result.json.
summary: Behaviour cloning trained the OFT action head on hidden states taken from the WRONG token positions. It was then evaluated on the correct ones. The head fit its (mis-specified) inputs cleanly and reproduced nothing in closed loop.

how_it_was_found.trigger: The recorded explanation -- 'the policy sees one RGB frame and no proprioception, so it cannot learn this from 358 transitions' -- was a hypothesis that had never been tested. Before building a proprioception pipeline on top of it, the cheaper diagnostic was run first: does the trained head reproduce the demonstrations OPEN-LOOP on the very frames it trained on?

open_loop_probe.reading: BC fit the data 5x better than SFT, to about 1 degree against a 167-degree action range. A head that fits its training data open-loop and then does nothing in closed loop is not a capacity or observability failure. That pointed at the train/eval path rather than the observation space.

the_defect.train_bc_py: lh[:, -model.chunk_len:, :]  -- the last chunk_len positions, by slicing
the_defect.why_the_slice_is_wrong: The prompt ends with '<action>.' AFTER the action tokens, so the action tokens are not the final positions of the sequence.

why_nothing_errored: Both tensors have shape [1, 30, 2048], so the shapes match, the forward pass succeeds, the loss descends, and the checkpoint saves. Only the closed-loop score reveals the problem, and it presents as 'the policy does not work' rather than as a fault.

consequence_for_the_record.superseded_claim: 'The policy observes ONE RGB frame and no proprioception ... adding proprioception is the change most likely to yield a working policy.' That claim was inferred from a failure whose actual cause was this defect. It is not supported by the evidence and is withdrawn.
consequence_for_the_record.still_true: The out-of-distribution hypothesis remains refuted independently (eval conditions perturb the arm by at most 2.6 degrees).
consequence_for_the_record.unaffected: The specification-gaming finding, the plunger-DoF finding and the entropy-sign finding are all measurements of other things and are untouched by this.

fix: train_bc.py now calls _gather_action_token_embeddings, identical to the other three tools. tests/unit_tests/test_g1_piston_feature_extraction_parity.py pins that all four tools agree; all 4 tests fail on the pre-fix source and pass on the fixed source, verified in both directions.
lesson: A training tool and an evaluation tool that disagree about the model's input produce a silently invalid result. Before attributing a negative result to a property of the task, verify that the model was scored on the same function it was trained on.
